title: One Punch Hero
description: Fan-made mod inspired by the One Punch Man anime. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with the original rights holders. All textures and code are original.
body:
Craft the full caped suit and gain overwhelming power: blazing speed, sky-high jumps with a mid-air dash, water running, and three tiers of reality-shattering punches — each with custom cinematic shockwave effects that glow in the dark.

Abilities (require the full 4-piece suit)

| Input | Ability |
|---|---|
| **Left Click** | **Normal Punch** — knocks back every mob around you and smashes a tunnel of blocks ahead. No cooldown. |
| **G** | **Serious Punch** — a 30-block widening cone. 500 damage, sonic booms, recoil. |
| **H** | **SUPER Serious Punch** — a 60-block devastation cone. 5000 damage, thunder, a ring of light, massive knockback. |
| **V** | **Super Run** (toggle) — extreme speed, run across water, trailing speed-streaks. |
| **Jump, then Jump again** | **Air Dash** — launch in the direction you're looking. Once per jump. |

Plus: mega jumps, no fall damage (with a landing shockwave), Resistance IV, fire immunity, and total knockback immunity.

Custom Effects:
Four hand-made particle types — expanding shockwave rings, bright impact flashes, rolling dust clouds, and speed lines — choreographed into clean expanding rings and directed bursts. Punches look like a scene from the anime, not a puff of smoke.

Crafting:
Hero Fabric (yellow wool + string + leather + yellow dye) builds the whole suit. The Caped Suit needs a Nether Star at its core.

- Minecraft **1.20.1**, **Forge 47.x**
- No dependencies
- Works in singleplayer and on servers
